verdict.rationale: Bulk operations are a fair question for a cloud deployment platform, so the axis applies. The pack documents a CLI, an MCP server and the Railway Agent, but they cover single actions such as creating projects or redeploying services. Nothing documents acting on many services, environments or deployments in one operation, and general-purpose tooling a user could script does not count as the capability itself.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can perform bulk operations across many items at once
